name: WebDesignerNews

sources.title: WebDesignerNews — live curated design/dev news feed; 'Submit an article' form on the homepage: Title + URL, 'Free Submission', 'no homepage submissions, no spammy affiliate links'; 'We will review it and approve it if relevant'

requirements: Free 'Submit an article' form on the homepage — Title + URL only, no account needed
Topics: web design/development, UX, apps, graphic design
Explicit rejections: homepage submissions and spammy affiliate links
Editorial review — 'we will review it and approve it if relevant'
preparation: A URL worth linking — a tool page, article, or resource a web designer would care about (not a bare homepage)
workflow: Fill the 'Submit an article' form on the homepage (Title + URL)
Wait for editorial review — approved links appear in the feed as story cards with outbound links
watchFor: Submit the tool/resource page, not the homepage — homepages are explicitly rejected
Cadence is slow — latest stories were 2-4 months old at fetch time; modest traffic
No account system — pure editorial curation
countsAsLive: The submission appears as a story card in the WebDesignerNews feed
